schema:name: OpenLink Structured Data Sniffer
schema:description: A browser extension that reveals and visualizes structured metadata (Microdata, RDFa, JSON-LD, Turtle, etc.) embedded within HTML documents. Modernized with React, TypeScript, and advanced data visualization.
schema:featureList: Detects and visualizes Microdata, JSON-LD, Turtle, RDFa, RDF/XML, POSH, JSON, and CSV
Interactive graph and table views (React Flow)
